title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: TIRES:TREAD (3,000 affected)
summary: THE THICKNESS OF THE MATERIAL UNDER THE TREAD COVERING THE NYLON OVERLAY IS NOT SUFFICIENT. CRACKS MAY DEVELOP IN THE SHOULDER AREA OF THE TIRE.

title: EAGLE TRAILERS INC: STEERING:POWER ASSIST (1,200 affected)
summary: CRACKS MAY DEVELOP IN THE WELDS THAT JOIN THE POWER STEERING UNIT MOUNTING BRACKET TO THE BUS FRONT END FRAMING. EVENTUALLY, THE WELDS MAY FAIL, CAUSING THE STEERING UNIT TO SEPARATE FROM THE FRONT END FRAME.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (9,197 affected)
summary: ATTACHING BOLTS WERE MISTAKENLY COATED WITH A SLIPPERY MATERIAL DURING PRODUCTION. THIS MATERIAL WILL ACT AS A LUBRICANT AND BOLTS MAY LOOSEN AND EVENTUALLY FALL OFF.

title: General Motors, LLC: HEATER:ELECTRICAL:DEFOGGER REAR-VIEW WINDOW:HOSE:D (25,053 affected)
summary: THE FUSIBLE LINK, WHICH PROTECTS ELECTRICAL COMPONENTS CONNECTED THROUGH THE IGNITION SWITCH, COULD COME OPEN WHILE REAR WINDOW DEFOGGER IS IN OPERATION. IF TWILIGHT SENTINEL SWITCH IS ON AND HEADLIGHT SWITCH IS OFF, AN OPEN LINK WILL RESULT IN LOSS OF HEADLIGHTS.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:INDEPENDENT FRONT CONTROL ARM:LOWER:BAL (3,959 affected)
summary: THE NUTS WHICH FASTEN THE LOWER ARM BALLJOINT TO THE STEERING KNUCKLE MAY NOT HAVE BEEN SECURELY TIGHTENED.

title: Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company: TIRES (12,000 affected)
summary: TIRES MAY UNSEAT FROM THE WHEEL AND DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE BEAD UNSEATING RESISTANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES".

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES (14,869 affected)
summary: TIRES WERE MOLDED WITH INCORRECT INFORMATION LISTED FOR PLY RATING AND LOAD RANGE. THESE TIRES ARE INCORRECTLY MARKED "6 PR" AND "LOAD RANGE C" INSTEAD OF "4 PR" AND "LOAD RANGE B". TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE LABELING REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 119, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES FOR VEHICLES OTHER THAN PASSENGER CARS".

title: ATLAS COPCO N.A., INC: TIRES:SIDEWALL (121 affected)
summary: TIRES MAY DEVELOP CRACKING OR CHAFING IN THE BEAD OR LOWER SIDEWALL AREA. TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES".

title: DUNLOP TIRE CORPORATION: TIRES (195 affected)
summary: ABSENCE OF REQUIRED MARKINGS, SUCH AS THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION SYMBOL, SERIAL IDENTIFICATION NUMBER, MANUFACTURER"S IDENTIFICATION, WEEK AND YEAR OF MANUFACTURE. TIRES DO NOT COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, "NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES".

title: SAAB CARS USA, INC.: POWER TRAIN:TRANSMISSION:AUTOMATIC (12,096 affected)
summary: A PROBLEM RELATING TO THE FRONT EXHAUST PIPE BRACKET ATTACHMENT COULD CAUSE LEAKING OF TRANSMISSION OIL. TRANSMISSION COULD LOCK UP DUE TO LACK OF PROPER OIL LUBRICATION.

title: Baker Boat Trailers, Inc.: BRAKES:AIR SYSTEMS:AIR SUPPLY SYSTEM (3,000 affected)
summary: VALVES MAY LOOSEN OR SEPARATE DUE TO BROKEN ASSEMBLY BOLTS, WHICH MAY HAVE BEEN BENT DURING INSTALLATION. IF SO, A TANK ON WHICH THE VALVE IS INSTALLED WILL LOSE AIR PRESSURE.

title: DOVER: EQUIPMENT:LIFT:WHEEL/TOWING APPARATUS (225 affected)
summary: THE PIVOT PIN WHICH JOINS THE BOOM OF THE WHEEL LIFT TO THE CARRIER MAY WEAR EXCESSIVELY AND COULD FRACTURE. SEPARATION OF THE CARRIER, AND THE TOWED VEHICLE, FROM THE BOOM THAT ATTACHES TO THE WRECKER WOULD OCCUR. THIS FAILURE IS DUE TO INADEQUATE LUBRICATION AND RESTRAINT OF THE PIVOT PIN.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: WHEELS:MULTIPLE (20 affected)
summary: THE DEFECT IS IN THE WHEEL RIM SIDE RING. THE WHEEL IS MADE UP OF A DISC AND RIM ASSEMBLY, SIDE RING AND LOCK RING. THE SIDE RING MAY HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY SIZED WITH RESPECT TO THE OTHER COMPONENTS.

title: Shyft Group: WHEELS:RIM BASE (1,671 affected)
summary: A FAULTY RIM DESIGN IN WHICH RIMS HAVE EITHER 8 OR 10 SLOTS (DEPENDING ON RIM TYPE) ALLOWS BENDING OF THE RIM UNDER A HEAVY LOAD.

title: Isuzu Motors Limited: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:DISC:CALIPER (3,342 affected)
summary: BOLT LOCATED IN REAR BRAKE CALIPERS MAY NOT BE SECURELY FASTENED. THE BOLT MAY COME OFF AND BRAKING ACTION COULD BECOME IMPAIRED.
